description:
President Rtn. Nalini Kannan represented Rotary Club of Deonar during her visit to Kashmir, attending the installation of the Rotary Satellite Club – Kashmir Valley and the formation of the Chinar Valley Satellite Club, an all-women Satellite Club. The Kashmir Valley Satellite Club was inaugurated in Srinagar with Hon’ble Chief Minister Omar Abdullah as Chief Guest. Kashmir News Service
President Nalini also participated in Project National Integration (PNI) at Machhal Army Village, visiting the Army Hospital and Army Goodwill School. Through PNI, clubs of Rotary District 3141 have undertaken impactful, need-based projects supporting both Army personnel and civilians in the region. District 3141 has an established association with service initiatives in the Machhal area. Rotary India
As part of the visit, President Nalini also visited the Line of Control (LOC) and a border area associated with a Maratha Regiment, gaining an insight into the environment and challenges faced by the Army
